entries.name: Compliance Reporting
entries.body: Regular compliance reports are generated for each dialect overlay's regulatory requirements.

entries.name: Incident Response
entries.body: Constitutional violations trigger immediate incident response: isolate, investigate, remediate, report.

entries.name: Third-Party Audit
entries.body: External auditors may request TransparencyPackets for any routing decision within retention period.

entries.name: Regression Testing
entries.body: 74 integration tests must pass before any routing module deployment. No exceptions.

entries.name: Triple-Vault Architecture
entries.body: All committed artifacts exist in 3 tiers: Local, Cloud, Archival. Single-tier storage is prohibited.

entries.name: Data Residency
entries.body: Sovereign-tagged data must be processed within the designated jurisdiction's compute zone.

entries.name: Encryption at Rest
entries.body: All stored data is encrypted at rest using jurisdiction-appropriate cryptographic standards.

entries.name: Key Management
entries.body: Cryptographic keys are managed per-dialect. No single key authority spans multiple sovereign zones.

entries.name: Retention Policy
entries.body: Knowledge artifacts: indefinite retention. Operational logs: domain-specific retention per INV-7c.

entries.name: Seat Assignment Protocol
entries.body: Council seats are assigned based on substrate archetype, not commercial relationship.

entries.name: Provisional Seat Review
entries.body: Provisional seats are reviewed every 6 months. Promotion to active requires 0.67 quorum.

entries.name: Conflict of Interest
entries.body: Council members must declare conflicts. Cross-ownership triggers automatic recusal.

entries.name: Amendment Process
entries.body: Doctrine amendments require proposer, version number, ratification timestamp. Undated amendments are invalid.

entries.name: Emergency Session
entries.body: The Convenor may call emergency Council sessions with 24-hour notice. Quorum reduced to 0.50 for emergencies.

entries.name: Functional Role Assignment
entries.body: 8 functional oversight roles (Safety, Sovereignty, Compute, etc.) are assigned to seats. Roles are not seats.

entries.name: Veto Authority
entries.body: Only the Convenor may exercise veto. Veto requires written justification and 72-hour review period.

entries.name: Ghost Seat Protocol
entries.body: S144 is permanently reserved. It cannot be assigned, voted on, or used for quorum calculation.

entries.name: Ratification Workflow
entries.body: Proposals → Discussion (7 days) → Vote (72 hours) → Ratification (Convenor) → Implementation.
